caption: Every lane below is derived from rails-lens/1 convention edges, which are capped at likely/candidate by construction — this is a triage queue to read, never a verdict to act on unread. A row can be wrong because the lens does not read a template language this app uses, because a render or an enqueue is dynamic and the lens refuses to guess it, or because a constant is reached by plain Ruby the lens does not model.

witnesses.detail: route target resolved by convention to app/controllers/orders_controller.rb

lanes.title: Routes with no reachable action
lanes.why: the routes DSL names controller#action; no public method of that name was found in the controller the naming convention points at. Wrong when the action is inherited from a superclass or generated by a gem — neither is indexed.

witnesses.detail: method export in a controller class

lanes.title: Public controller actions with no route
lanes.why: a method in a controller class that no route_action edge targets. Method VISIBILITY is not indexed — it is read with a line scan for a bare `private`/`protected`, which misses the `private def foo` and `private :foo` forms, so a private helper can appear here.

lanes.title: Views never rendered by any render edge
lanes.why: no render_view/render_partial/view_component_render edge targets this template. Render edges are convention-derived and the lens refuses a dynamic `render(some_variable)` rather than guessing it, so a reachable template can appear here.

witnesses.detail: entities/1 indexed a definition of AuditEntry here

lanes.title: Models referenced only from their own file
lanes.why: no rails-lens edge from any OTHER file points at this model file. Plain Ruby references (a constant used in a service object, a bare `Order.find`) are not modelled by this lens at all, so this lane is a starting point for a usages check, not evidence of dead code.

witnesses.detail: entities/1 indexed a definition of CleanupJob here

lanes.title: Jobs never enqueued
lanes.why: no job_enqueue edge targets this job class. The lens reads `.perform_later`/`.perform_now` call sites in the file trees it dispatches; a job enqueued from an undispatched tree, from a cron schedule file, or through a class-name STRING is invisible to it.

witnesses.detail: defined in config/locales/en.yml; no rails-lens/1 i18n_key edge names it

lanes.title: Locale keys never referenced
lanes.why: the key appears in a config/locales YAML file and no i18n_key edge names it. The lens resolves `t("literal")` only: an interpolated key, a lazy `t(".relative")` and every call site in a template language the lens does not read are all invisible to it, and a key referenced only from one of those looks unused here.

notes: counts are TRUE totals over the whole index; a lane past its cap reports the total beside the page and sets truncated
the report is recomputed per request and stored nowhere
